name: Seifuku Rakuen Extend
source:
Kana, who’s started dating her part-time job junior, Eita, is growing frustrated. It’s been three months, and they haven’t even kissed. The relationship isn’t progressing at all.

Kana has an older brother, but he’s so careless with women that she can’t imagine getting any useful advice from him. Instead, she decides to visit her cousin, who lives nearby, for some relationship counseling.

Her cousin seems to have a boyfriend, so Kana tries to pry out some tips and vent her frustrations while discussing her love life. Eventually, she concludes that she needs to be more assertive and take a more… physical approach to move things forward.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ071166.html/]dlsite[/url]]
